style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-size:8pt;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-size:14pt;font-weight:bold;">Franklin Street Properties Corp. Announces</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-size:14pt;font-weight:bold;">Third Quarter 2026 Results</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;"><img src="fsp-ex99d1001.jpg" alt="Graphic" style="display:inline-block;height:0.75pt;width:319.5pt;"></font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-size:8pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 7pt 0pt;">Wakefield, MA&#8212; October 27, 2026&#8212;Franklin Street Properties Corp. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;, &#8220;FSP&#8221;, &#8220;we&#8221; or &#8220;our&#8221;) (NYSE American: &#160;FSP), a real estate investment trust (REIT), announced its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. &#160; &#160; </p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 6pt 0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">George J. Carter, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, commented as follows: </b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">&#8220;As we continue to move through 2026, our focus remains squarely on trying to maximize shareholder value through our expanded evaluation of strategic alternatives, proactive asset management, expense management, and efforts to improve leasing and occupancy.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">During the quarter, we endeavored to make progress on several important strategic initiatives, while maintaining financial and strategic flexibility.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Importantly, our recent refinancing of our outstanding debt has provided the Company with increased flexibility, allowing us to pursue strategic initiatives in a disciplined and thoughtful manner. This position allows us to act more opportunistically as market conditions evolve and as opportunities emerge.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On July 8, 2026, we sold our Greenwood Plaza property located in Englewood, Colorado to University of Colorado Health for a gross selling price of approximately $19.4 million. &#160;In addition, on July 8, 2026, we used approximately $8.5 million of the net proceeds from the disposition for the repayment of debt, including interest and fees. &#160;We believe that this disposition reflects disciplined execution, targeted owner-user marketing, and continued progress on our broader strategic objectives.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">During the third quarter and into October, the Company continued its expanded strategic review process with BofA Securities and JLL Securities serving as our co-advisors. The process has included extensive market outreach, multiple rounds of price discovery and evaluation of potential Company, portfolio, subportfolio and individual asset transactions. However, office investment demand and liquidity remain uneven nationally and are challenged in several of our markets.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Based on the recommendations of our co-advisors and the results of the process to date, the Company has identified a number of individual asset and subportfolio sale opportunities that it intends to actively pursue in the fourth quarter. The Company will continue working with its co-advisors and prospective purchasers regarding these potential opportunities and any other potential transactions that may arise. Completion of any such sales or transactions will depend on reaching acceptable final pricing terms and counterparties completing due diligence processes and finalizing financing arrangements.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Operationally, we remain focused on improving occupancy, extending lease duration, prudently managing operating expenses, and allocating capital where we believe it can generate the greatest long-term value for our shareholders. &#160;Notably, we were successful in reducing general and administrative expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 by $2.6 million compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025 primarily as a result of lower personnel costs.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">We also continue to prioritize leasing and asset management initiatives across the portfolio. These efforts remain important because changes in occupancy, lease duration, capital requirements and tenant quality can materially affect the value and marketability of individual assets.&#8221;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-size:8pt;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></div><div style="clear:both;margin-bottom:27.35pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></div></div><hr style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Dividend</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;line-height:12.6pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On March 9, 2026, the Company announced that the Board of Directors had determined to suspend the payment of quarterly dividends. &#160;The Board did so in part to redeploy that capital into leasing efforts intended to enhance the value of our portfolio.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;line-height:12.6pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-size:12.6pt;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;line-height:12.6pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company estimates that suspension of the dividend will preserve approximately $4.1 million in cash on an annualized basis. The Board and the Company will reassess, on a quarterly basis, when and if quarterly dividend payments can be reinstated and will announce any change to the dividend policy. &#160; </p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;line-height:12.6pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-size:12.6pt;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;line-height:12.6pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 7pt 0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">T</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">As of January 1, 2023, we consolidated the operations of our Monument Circle sponsored REIT into our financial statements and on June 6, 2025, the property held by Monument Circle was sold and Monument Circle and the corporation that had been its sole member were dissolved on December 9, 2025. &#160;Additional information about the consolidation of Monument Circle can be found in Note 2, &#8220;Significant Accounting Policies - Variable Interest Entities (VIEs)&#8221;, Note 3, &#8220;Related Party Transactions and Investments in Non-Consolidated Entities - Management fees and interest income from loans&#8221; and Note 10, &#8220;Disposition of Properties and Assets Held for Sale&#8221;, in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for year ended December 31, 2025.<font style="font-family:'Cambria';"> &#160;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New website regularly for important information about us and, if they are interested in automatically receiving news and information as soon as it is posted, to sign up for E-mail Alerts. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">About Franklin Street Properties Corp.</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Franklin Street Properties Corp., based in Wakefield, Massachusetts, is focused on infill and central business district (CBD) office properties in the U.S. Southwest and Mountain West, as well as select opportunistic markets. &#160;FSP is focused on long-term growth and appreciation. &#160;FSP is a Maryland corporation that operates in a manner intended to qualify as a real estate investment trust (REIT) for federal income tax purposes. &#160;To learn more about FSP please visit our website at www.fspreit.com.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></div></div><hr style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></td><td style="vertical-align:bottom;white-space:normal;width:8.58%;border-bottom:3px double #000000;margin:0pt;padding:0pt;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:right;margin:0pt 3.6pt 0pt 0pt;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;"> 103,623</font></p></td><td style="vertical-align:bottom;white-space:normal;width:0.45%;margin:0pt;padding:0pt;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></td></tr></table></div><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></div></div><hr style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;color:#000000;height:2pt;line-height:0;margin-bottom:30pt;margin-left:10.35%;margin-right:10.35%;margin-top:30pt;page-break-after:always;width:79.3%;border-width:0;"><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:10.35%;padding-right:10.35%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:27.35pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;">-14-</p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Funds From Operations (&#8220;FFO&#8221;) </b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company evaluates performance based on Funds From Operations, which we refer to as FFO, as management believes that FFO represents the most accurate measure of activity and is the basis for distributions paid to equity holders. &#160;The Company defines FFO as net income or loss (computed in accordance with GAAP), excluding gains (or losses) from sales of property, hedge ineffectiveness, acquisition costs of newly acquired properties that are not capitalized and lease acquisition costs that are not capitalized plus depreciation and amortization, including amortization of acquired above and below market lease intangibles and impairment charges on mortgage loans, properties or investments in non-consolidated REITs, and after adjustments to exclude equity in income or losses from, and, to include the proportionate share of FFO from, non-consolidated REITs. &#160; &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">FFO should not be considered as an alternative to net income or loss (determined in accordance with GAAP), nor as an indicator of the Company&#8217;s financial performance, nor as an alternative to cash flows from operating activities (determined in accordance with GAAP), nor as a measure of the Company&#8217;s liquidity, nor is it necessarily indicative of sufficient cash flow to fund all of the Company&#8217;s needs. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Other real estate companies and the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts, or NAREIT, may define this term in a different manner. &#160;We have included the NAREIT FFO as of May 17, 2016 in the table and note that other REITs may not define FFO in accordance with the current NAREIT definition or may interpret the current NAREIT definition differently than we do. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">We believe that in order to facilitate a clear understanding of the results of the Company, FFO should be examined in connection with net income or loss and cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities in the consolidated financial statements.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Adjusted Funds From Operations (&#8220;AFFO&#8221;)</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company also evaluates performance based on Adjusted Funds From Operations, which we refer to as AFFO. &#160;The Company defines AFFO as (1) FFO, (2) excluding loss on extinguishment of debt that is non-cash, (3) excluding our proportionate share of FFO and including distributions received, from non-consolidated REITs, (4) excluding the effect of straight-line rent, (5) plus the amortization of deferred financing costs and original issue discounts, (6) plus the value of shares issued as compensation and (7) less recurring capital expenditures that are generally for maintenance of properties, which we call non-investment capex or are second generation capital expenditures. &#160;Second generation costs include re-tenanting space after a tenant vacates, which include tenant improvements and leasing commissions. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">We exclude development/redevelopment activities, capital expenditures planned at acquisition and costs to reposition a property. We also exclude first generation leasing costs, which are generally to fill vacant space in properties we acquire or were planned for at acquisition. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">AFFO should not be considered as an alternative to net income or loss (determined in accordance with GAAP), nor as an indicator of the Company&#8217;s financial performance, nor as an alternative to cash flows from operating activities (determined in accordance with GAAP), nor as a measure of the Company&#8217;s liquidity, nor is it necessarily indicative of sufficient cash flow to fund all of the Company&#8217;s needs. &#160;Other real estate companies may define this term in a different manner. &#160;We believe that in order to facilitate a clear understanding of the results of the Company, AFFO should be examined in connection with net income or loss and cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities in the consolidated financial statements. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p></div></div><hr style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;color:#000000;height:2pt;line-height:0;margin-bottom:30pt;margin-left:10.35%;margin-right:10.35%;margin-top:30pt;page-break-after:always;width:79.3%;border-width:0;"><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:10.35%;padding-right:10.35%;position:relative;"><div style="margin-top:27.35pt;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 30pt 0pt;">-15-</p></div><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt;">Franklin Street Properties Corp. Earnings Release</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt;">Supplementary Schedule I</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt;">Reconciliation and Definition of Sequential Same Store results to property Net Operating Income (NOI) and Net Income</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Net Operating Income (&#8220;NOI&#8221;)</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company provides property performance based on Net Operating Income, which we refer to as NOI. &#160;Management believes that investors are interested in this information. &#160;NOI is a non-GAAP financial measure that the Company defines as net income or loss (the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure) plus general and administrative expenses, depreciation and amortization, including amortization of acquired above and below market lease intangibles and impairment charges, interest expense, less equity in earnings of nonconsolidated REITs, interest income, management fee income, hedge ineffectiveness, gains or losses on extinguishment of debt, gains or losses on the sale of assets and excludes non-property specific income and expenses. &#160;The information presented includes footnotes and the data is shown by region with properties owned in the periods presented, which we call Sequential Same Store. &#160;The comparative Sequential Same Store results include properties held for all periods presented. &#160;We exclude properties that have been placed in service, but that do not have operating activity for all periods presented, dispositions and significant nonrecurring income such as bankruptcy settlements and lease termination fees. &#160;NOI, as defined by the Company, may not be comparable to NOI reported by other REITs that define NOI differently. NOI should not be considered an alternative to net income or loss as an indication of our performance or to cash flows as a measure of the Company&#8217;s liquidity or its ability to make distributions. &#160;The calculations of NOI and Sequential Same Store are shown in the following table:</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><div align="left"><table
